questions.q: Why can't hydrochloric acid be used to acidify before the silver nitrate test?
questions.a: It adds Cl⁻ ions, giving a false white precipitate

questions.q: A sample gives a red flame and fizzes with acid, turning limewater milky. Name and write its formula.
A salt gives a yellow flame and a white precipitate with acidified barium chloride. Name it. (2)
questions.model: Yellow flame = Na⁺. White precipitate with BaCl₂ = sulfate. Sodium sulfate.

questions.q: Why add dilute nitric acid before silver nitrate?
questions.a: To remove carbonate ions that would also give a precipitate
